title: Generated translation template uses `name` of TabContainer's children instead of their `metadata/_tab_name`
body:
### Tested versions

- Noticed in: Godot v4.7.1.stable
- Reproduced in: Godot v4.8.dev (5ec4857b3)

### System information

Artix Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 11 Aug 2026 17:35:51 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (1920x1080 @ 59.96 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 610.57.04) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.53 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When generating a POT file to translate my game, I noticed that the tab titles that I set in my `TabContainer` didn't appear in the generated file, instead the names of the children of the `TabContainer` were used as translation keys.

This is caused by [`PackedSceneEditorTranslationParserPlugin::parse_file` ](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/editor/translations/packed_scene_translation_parser_plugin.cpp#L152) using `get_node_name` instead of getting the `_tab_name` property/metadata that was added to the nodes by their parent `TabContainer`. I don't know what would be the proper way for the TranslationParserPlugin to access this string.

If the `_tab_name` is set through the editor, the current automatic translation will not work because the `TabContainer` properly gives the `_tab_name` for the `TabBar` to translate, even though the msgid generated was the `name` of the node.

### Steps to reproduce

* Create a UI scene
* Add a TabContainer node
* Add a child to the TabContainer
* Change the tab title in the TabContainer's Inspector panel
* Save the scene
* Add the scene to the localization template generation, and generate a template

-> The template has a translation key with the node's name instead of the tab's title set in the Inspector panel.

Creating and filling a .po translation file with GetText will show that the key is wrong: the tab's title won't be translated in game.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[tab_translation_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31616232/tab_translation_test.zip)
